sentences.text: The ACT Board of Inquiry examined possible misconduct by police, prosecutors and the Victims of Crime Commissioner in a criminal matter.

cites.document: Final Report, Board of Inquiry: Criminal Justice System
Final Report, Board of Inquiry: Criminal Justice System

sentences.text: The Board found that police had investigated thoroughly, although mistakes caused unnecessary distress without affecting the investigation or prejudicing the case.

cites.document: Final Report, Board of Inquiry: Criminal Justice System

sentences.text: The Board also made serious misconduct findings against the then Director of Public Prosecutions, while declining to determine fitness to remain in office or practise as a barrister.

cites.document: Final Report, Board of Inquiry: Criminal Justice System

sentences.text: Its ten numbered recommendations address charging decisions, counselling records, disclosure, police dealings with defence lawyers, retrial decisions and complaints between agencies.

items.quote: Regrettably, I have found it necessary to make several serious findings of misconduct on the part of Mr Shane Drumgold SC, the Director of Public Prosecutions.

cite.document: Final Report, Board of Inquiry: Criminal Justice System

items.quote: None of these mistakes actually affected the substance of the investigation and none of them prejudiced the case.

cite.document: Final Report, Board of Inquiry: Criminal Justice System

items.quote: I recommend that the government, in consultation with stakeholders, enact legislation to codify the scope and content of the obligation of disclosure owed by the Prosecution in criminal proceedings.
